货物不能经手。三件货物要沿着队列传下去，每一棒都靠两个人撑起的一方袱布。: Three cargos must travel down the line without touching a single hand. Each pair of teammates shares a square of cloth for their leg of the relay.
队员两两撑布，面对面接力传递。: Pairs face each other and pass the cargo from cloth to cloth.
关帝庙前的石马与庙门。: The stone horse and gateway outside Guan Di Temple.
两人一组撑开袱布，在指定区域接力。传递时只能用布，不能用手拿货物。: Work in pairs, holding your cloth open in the marked area. Pass the cargo using only the cloth, never your hands.
把大蒜、土豆、玉米三件货物全部传完。: Get all three items to the end: the garlic, the potato and the ear of corn.
一面鼓，一圈绳。大家手里各有一根绳，球能颠多高、多稳，取决于全队的节奏。: One drum, a circle of ropes and a ball in the air. How high and how steadily it bounces depends on whether your team can find a common rhythm.
队员围住鼓面，各执一根长绳。: Players stand around the drum, each holding a long rope.
队员各拉一根鼓绳，把球放上鼓面。配合收放绳子颠球，手不碰鼓面。: Each player takes one rope. Place the ball on the drum and work the ropes together to bounce it without touching the drumhead.
球不落地，连续颠起 8 次。: Bounce the ball 8 times in a row without letting it hit the ground.
草坪上立着一面计分靶。队员轮流起脚，每一球的得分都算进全队的成绩。: A scoring target stands on the lawn. Take turns shooting; every kick counts toward the team score.
队员将足球踢向圆形计分靶。: A player aims a football at the circular scoring target.
古镇建筑旁的大草坪。: The Grand Lawn beside the old town buildings.
全队累计 15 人次，每人有两次射门机会，由守关人记录得分。: Your team takes 15 turns. Each turn gets two shots; the station keeper records the points.
全队总分超过 250 分。: Score more than 250 points as a team.
个人两球合计超过 32 分，可随机抽取一张能免一次惩罚的道具卡。恰好 32 分是: Score more than 32 points across your two shots to draw a random card that cancels one penalty. Ask the referee whether exactly 32 qualifies.
气球区只留给每位队员十五秒。场内的人抓紧时间挥锤，场外的人排好下一棒。: You have just fifteen seconds in the balloon ring. Swing while the clock is running; the next teammate should be ready to step in.
「一锤定音」挑战的充气锤道具。: The inflatable mallet used in Hammer Time.
俯瞰绿树围合的大草坪。: An overhead view of the tree-lined Grand Lawn.
15 位队员依次接力，每人有 15 秒进入指定区域敲气球。: Send in 15 teammates, one after another. Each has 15 seconds inside the marked area to pop balloons.
全队合计敲破超过 12 个气球。: Pop more than 12 balloons between you.
在梅泾剧场演一出没有台词的戏：台上两人知道谜底，台下队友要把他们的动作猜成古词。: At Meijing Theatre, two players know the words but cannot say a thing. Can the rest of the team read a classical expression in their gestures?
「你比划我猜」的动作游戏示意。: A charades player demonstrates a prompt without speaking.
梅泾剧场的临街正面。: The street-facing entrance to Meijing Theatre.
选两位队员上台看词卡，只能用动作提示，不能说话。其余队员负责猜词。: Choose two teammates to read the word cards onstage. They may gesture but not speak. Everyone else guesses.
在 120 秒内尽量猜对，交守关人计数。: Guess as many expressions as possible in 120 seconds. The station keeper keeps score.
奥秘卡就是这次看展的题单。与队友在展柜之间循题找物，把线索一条条填回卡上。: Your mystery card is your guide to the exhibits. Follow its clues from case to case and fill in the answers together.
珍宝馆内环形步道与展柜。: The circular walkway and display cases inside the Treasure Gallery.
馆内展陈文字示例。: An example of an exhibit label in the gallery.
全队到馆内领取奥秘卡，根据卡上的提示寻找对应藏品。: Collect a mystery card as a team, then follow the prompts to find the matching objects.
填齐卡上的奥秘信息，交给守关人核验。: Complete every clue and hand the card to the station keeper for checking.
到福善寺暂歇脚步，和队友一起动手，把艾草做成一柄小锤。图中的成品可作样式参考。: Pause at Fushan Temple to make a small mugwort mallet with your teammates. The finished piece in the photo shows one way yours could look.
红柄艾草锤与挂绳的成品示例。: A finished mugwort mallet with a red handle and hanging loop.
福善寺的山门与屋檐。: The gateway and eaves of Fushan Temple.
和队员一起领取现场材料，跟随守关人的指引制作艾草锤。: Collect the materials together and follow the station keeper’s instructions to make your mallet.
全队共同完成艾草锤 DIY。: Finish the mugwort mallet craft as a team.
帽枝上的糖近在眼前，伸手却不算数。戴帽的人得让糖摆到嘴边，才能吃到这一口。: The sweet dangling from your hat is almost within reach, but hands are off limits. Swing it close enough to catch a bite.
队员仰头去够帽枝上悬着的糖。: A player tips their head back to reach the sweet hanging from the hat.
选 7 位队员戴上诸葛帽，双手放在身后，不能用手碰帽子或糖果。: Choose 7 players to wear the Zhuge hats. Keep both hands behind your back; do not touch the hat or the sweets.
晃动帽枝，用嘴咬到吊起的糖果。: Set the rod swinging and catch the hanging sweet with your mouth.
先闻铃声，再见其人。巡捕双脚系着铃铛，携带软质道具，在全古镇巡游，没有固定守候点: You may hear him before you see him: bells are tied to his ankles. The Constable carries a soft prop and patrols the entire town rather than waiting at a fixed post.
任一队员被巡捕的软质道具碰到，在场队员就要依次和巡捕划拳。: If the Constable tags anyone with his soft prop, every teammate present takes a turn at a hand game against him.
至少半数队员获胜即可免罚；若巡捕赢过半数，就会从队伍手中随机抽走一份碎片。: If at least half the team wins, there is no penalty. If the Constable beats more than half of you, he takes one random fragment from your team.
黑红捕快服与高帽的造型参考。: The Constable’s black-and-red uniform and tall hat.
巡捕划拳挑战的手势示意。: Hand signals used in the Constable’s challenge.
濮绸作坊一带有位黑袍游侠。凑齐至少 5 位同伴，就能向他讨教一套「盖世武功」。: Look for a black-robed traveller near the silk workshop. Gather at least five companions and ask him to teach you his legendary moves.
全员跟着游侠学三招：闪身步、浪子踢球、狗熊哆嗦毛。: Everyone copies the Wanderer’s three moves: the sidestep, the rover’s kick and the bear’s shake.
拍摄记录学会的动作，得到游侠认可后领取线索。: Record the moves. When the Wanderer approves your performance, collect your clue.
黑袍游侠的背影与动作参考。: The black-robed Wanderer seen from behind, mid-move.
活动方案中的三招动作示意。: The three moves illustrated in the event guide.
镖码散落在福善塔周围。先找宝箱，再去见镖师，这趟寻镖才算走完。: The shipment markers are scattered around Fushan Pagoda. Find the chests first, then take your discoveries to the Caravan Guard.
在塔周围寻找 5 个装有货物的镖码宝箱，再前往镖师处，解开箱中的谜题。: Find the five cargo chests around the pagoda. Take them to the Guard and solve the puzzles inside.
替镖师找回散落的镖码，他会赠给队伍一条线索。: Recover the missing shipment markers to earn a clue from the Guard.
镖局门前的镖师造型参考。: The Caravan Guard outside the escort agency.
寻找镖码时留意这样的宝箱。: Look for chests like this when hunting for the shipment markers.
魔方塔旁，大理寺卿正在办案。画面里一处穿帮、两幅图间一点差异，都可能是破案的关键: The High Magistrate is investigating a case beside Cube Tower. A detail out of place or a difference between two pictures could crack the case.
随机抽取 2 宗「案件」，全队一起找不同、找不合理之处或穿帮细节。: Draw two case files at random. Work together to spot differences, inconsistencies or anachronisms.
指出两宗案件里的疑点，协助结案后向大理寺卿领取奖励线索。: Identify the suspicious details in both cases, then collect your reward clue from the Magistrate.
大理寺卿的红色官服与冠帽。: The High Magistrate’s red court robes and official cap.
古装场景「大家来找茬」题型示意。: A sample spot-the-difference puzzle set in imperial times.
北更楼旁的黑袍商人做两种生意：可以明码换卡，也可以凭本事向他赢一张。: The black-robed trader by the North Watchtower offers two ways to get a card: pay his asking price or win one in a contest.
攒下的本队交子可以换特殊卡。想比试，就和商人连玩三局；具体比什么，由商人现场出题: Trade your team’s jiaozi for special cards, or challenge the trader to three rounds. He chooses the contest on the spot.
连赢三局，可随机抽取一张卡。直接购买时，不同卡片的价格和用途各不相同。: Win three times in a row to draw a random card. If you buy instead, check each card’s price and effect.
黑市商人全身披着带兜帽的黑袍。: The trader wears a hooded black robe from head to toe.
在入住酒店右侧的公寓楼附近寻找蒙面人。他摆下的不是擂台，而是一局「极速三子棋」。: Look for the masked figure near the apartments to the right of your hotel. His challenge is not a duel but a game of speed tic-tac-toe.
找到大侠并发起对局。赶往棋盘落子，在速度与布局之间做决定。: Find the Hero and challenge him. Race to the board to place your piece, balancing speed with strategy.
在极速三子棋中战胜蒙面大侠，即可获得线索。: Beat the Masked Hero at speed tic-tac-toe to earn a clue.
蒙面大侠的黑衣与面罩。: The Masked Hero’s dark clothing and face covering.
队员跑向地面九宫格摆放棋子。: Players run to place pieces on the life-size grid.
队员在九宫格棋盘前争先落子。: Players race to claim squares on the tic-tac-toe board.
领取一个 NPC 任务的通关奖励。: Claim the completion reward for one NPC quest.
掷出 4、5、6 点可得 100 交子。: Roll a 4, 5 or 6 to win 100 jiaozi.
免去一次巡捕惩罚。: Cancel one penalty from the Constable.
从巡捕处随机取一份碎片。: Take one random fragment from the Constable.
指定一位 NPC 向后续队伍给出假消息；全场仅一张。: Choose an NPC to give false information to later teams. Only one of these cards exists.
到濮院，入戏: Arrive in Puyuan, step into the story
苏州微软公司集合，乘车前往濮院。: Meet at Microsoft Suzhou and take the coach to Puyuan.
梅尚度假酒店 · 濮院镇寺浜路，濮院时尚古镇。: Meshang Resort Hotel, Sibang Road, Puyuan Fashion Ancient Town.
梅尚度假酒店 · 梅园厅，团队桌餐。: Team lunch at shared tables in Meiyuan Hall, Meshang Resort Hotel.
按现场通知集合。: Meet at the spot announced on the day.
领取任务卡，组队寻找诗句碎片。: Collect your quest cards and hunt for fragments of the poem together.
自由活动 · 晚餐自理: Free time · Dinner on your own
留一段水巷时光，自行安排晚餐。: Explore the canals at your own pace and choose your own dinner spot.
慢游水乡，返程: A morning by the canals, then home
跟讲解游古镇，或参加已报名体验: Join the guided walk or your booked workshop
两项择一；讲解按每组 45 人组织。: Choose one. Guided walks run in groups of 45.
乘大巴返回苏州；上车点以现场通知为准。: Take the coach back to Suzhou. The boarding point will be announced on the day.
需预留 3 小时，留意退房与返程时间: Allow 3 hours; plan around check-out and the return coach.
方案注明无库存: Listed as out of stock in the event plan
